text: Saved host credentials let you reconnect instantly without re-entering IP, port, or password
quote: No more re-entering IPs, ports, or password. Everything is saved, so you connect instantly.

text: Groups can be configured with a jump host so every host inside automatically routes through it
quote: if you configure a jump host for a Group, every Host within it will automatically connect through that jump host

text: Keychain credentials can be referenced by multiple hosts and groups without duplication, and updates propagate automatically
quote: Items in the Keychain can be referenced by multiple Hosts and Groups without duplicating them.

text: Commands can be broadcast to all open terminal sessions at once and saved as a reusable template
quote: You can broadcast a command to all sessions simultaneously and save the entire setup as a reusable template.

text: Snippets can be executed on multiple hosts simultaneously from the Snippets screen
quote: execute them on multiple hosts at once from the Snippets screen

text: Plain-language descriptions can be converted into shell commands using built-in AI
quote: Termius can convert a plain-language description into a shell command... Termius generates the command using AI.

text: Terminal session logs are automatically collected, synced across devices, searchable, and bookmarkable
quote: Termius automatically collects terminal session logs for every host. Logs are synced across devices and shared with your team. You can search logs and save them using Bookmarks.

text: Every account includes a personal credential vault synced across all devices
quote: Every account includes a Personal vault, accessible only to you and synced across all your devices.

text: Adding team members automatically creates a shared Team vault for collaborative infrastructure management
quote: When you add team members, a Team vault is created automatically. This vault is shared with all team members, allowing your team to manage infrastructure together.

text: Multiplayer terminal sessions let teammates collaborate and troubleshoot together in real time
quote: Collaborate in the terminal in real-time using the multiplayer sessions. Troubleshoot together or guide teammates through your workflow.

text: Autocomplete suggests frequently used commands, arguments, and file paths
quote: With autocomplete suggestions for frequently used commands, arguments, and file paths, you can save time and focus on more important things.

text: SSH keys can be created and managed with passphrase protection, encrypted and accessible from any device
quote: Create and manage your SSH keys with passphrase protection. Everything is encrypted and easily accessible from any device.

text: SSH authentication supports FIDO2 security keys and multi-factor authentication
quote: Secure SSH authentication with FIDO2 security keys and MFA.

text: Connections can be secured with device-bound keys and biometric protection like Windows Hello, Touch/Face ID, or Android biometrics
quote: Secure connections with device-bound keys and biometric protection with Windows Hello, Touch ID/Face ID, or Android biometrics.

text: Infrastructure is stored and encrypted locally, letting you connect directly to servers without internet, a proxy, or VPN
quote: Termius doesn't depend on the cloud to manage your access. Your infrastructure is stored and encrypted locally. Connect directly to your servers without the internet, a proxy, or VPN.

text: One-click secure connections from any device with team collaboration via an encrypted cloud vault
quote: Connect securely to remote infrastructure with just one click from any device and collaborate with your team in an encrypted cloud vault.

text: A host only needs to be configured once and can then be connected to in multiple ways without duplicating settings
quote: You only need to configure the machine once and then you are able to connect to it in multiple ways without duplicating settings.

text: Hosts sync across iOS and Android devices, keeping them available everywhere
quote: Termius syncs your hosts across iOS and Android, keeping them available on all your devices.

text: Team members can view the latest terminal session on any host for handovers, collaboration, and audits
quote: Make your team view the latest terminal sessions on any host, regardless of who connected, for easier task handovers, collaboration, and audits.

text: Additional vaults can be created to separate data and control access across team members or environments
quote: You can also create additional vaults to separate data and control access across different team members or environments.
